rationale: PR #324 proved the current explanation contract cannot represent one practical customer illustration with both admitted education-publication lineage and Decision-Gate-approved product finding/evidence lineage. This extension adds a distinct PRACTICAL_ILLUSTRATION section and a generic deterministic reviewed-profile composer. Existing EXAMPLE remains education-only.
authority_impact: No new insurance authority. Practical illustrations require admitted education plus already-approved product findings/evidence. They do not satisfy reasoning or evidence requirements, do not change Decision Gate output, and are omitted when typed facts or reviewed profile parameters are insufficient or ambiguous.
